role: Subprocess plugin binary (meta-git) for the meta CLI that implements multi-repo git commands: recursive clone of child repos, per-repo commit, status, update, snapshots, worktrees, and SSH agent setup. Built on meta_plugin_protocol/meta_git_lib/meta_core/loop_lib as path deps to sibling workspace members.
northstar: Meta makes multi-repo feel like monorepo without the downsides; the canon machinery stays green, versioned by the parent distribution.
